Move over, premium handhelds! I found the absolute best budget gaming device of 2026, and it only costs 12 bucks.
Taking heavy design inspiration from the classic Game Boy DMG, this absolute powerhouse features a durable polycarbonate shell, a high-res dot-matrix display, and a D-pad that actually feels surprisingly good. I’ve already got 60 hours into the main campaign! We’re taking a look at the build quality, the single front-facing speaker, and unlocking a secret Konami code Easter egg hidden in the main menu. #Shorts #HandheldGaming #TechReview #RetroGaming #GamingCommunity #BudgetTech #EasterEgg
title: The BEST $12 Handheld Of 2026! #handheld
